persona.label: Rushed but qualified
persona.description: Busy professional between meetings. Terse, answers several things at once. Should be transferred.
persona.behavior: You are between meetings and have about five minutes. Your first reply says something like "ok but make it fast, I'm busy." Use short, lowercase texts with no pleasantries. When asked something, answer it, and volunteer one or two related facts if it saves time. Round numbers the way people do ("about 520", "owe like 310k"). If the assistant is slow or repetitive, show mild impatience. You want a lower rate and you want to talk to someone today.

transcript.text: Hi Taylor, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.

handoff.borrower_summary: Taylor Brooks, primary residence worth ~$520k, owes ~$310k at 7.25%, self-reported credit 740+.
handoff.recommended_next_step: Call promptly and keep it brief; borrower is busy. Discuss rate-and-term refinance options.

objections.rationale: The borrower said "make it fast, im busy" but agreed to continue. The agent replied "Got it, I'll keep it quick" and asked compact, combined questions, which respected the time constraint. It did not offer a callback-time option, but the borrower had already chosen to proceed by text, so the omission is minor.

judge.naturalness_rationale: The messages are short and warm, and they adapt to a busy borrower. Turn 2 bundles value and balance into one question. Turn 4 gives credit bands with a reassuring "not a credit check" note. There is no filler or repetition.
judge.experience_rationale: The intake was done in three quick exchanges, matching the borrower's request. Turn 6 says who will contact them ("a licensed loan officer"), how ("call you at this number"), and when ("usually within 5 minutes"), and honestly notes "they may double-check a few details."
judge.handoff_summary_rationale: The summary is accurate and complete: value, balance, rate, credit band, occupancy, timeline, and LTV are correct, with no missing fields and an actionable next step that reflects the borrower being busy. However, "i want to move asap" is ambiguous (move homes soon vs. move quickly on the refinance). It was recorded as "move ASAP" without flagging it in open_questions. That matters, because a planned move could change whether refinancing makes sense.

annotations.note: It clearly identifies itself as "an automated assistant," references the inquiry the borrower just submitted, and offers STOP up front.
"Got it, I'll keep it quick" acknowledges the busy borrower, and the agent immediately combines two questions to save time.
It offers easy credit bands and clarifies "This is just your own estimate, not a credit check," which lowers friction.
The agent did not clarify the ambiguous "i want to move asap" (relocating vs. moving fast), a detail that could affect whether refinancing is worthwhile.
The handoff message sets honest expectations about who will call, how, and when, without promising the borrower won't repeat anything or implying any rate or approval.

judge.overall_notes: This was an efficient, compliant intake that respected a busy borrower and ended with a clear, honest next step. The only gap is the unclarified "move asap" comment, which the loan officer should confirm.
